biggest_catch: You must have been a Together Credit Union member for at least 90 days to qualify for the $50 referral bonus, and the friend must open a new consumer checking account at a branch with your coupon — plus the fine print states no annual cap on your $50 referral bonuses.
catches: Referring member must have been a member for at least 90 days to qualify for the $50 referral bonus.

Referred friend/family member must open a new consumer checking account (membership eligibility and account approval required); the coupon form must be taken to the nearest branch to open the account.

Referrer receives the $50 incentive once the friend opens their account; the friend's own bonus $150 (up to $200 total) requires $500+ direct deposit, 5 debit transactions, and eStatements within 60 days — that larger bonus is the friend's, not the referrer's.
No annual cap on the referrer's $50 bonuses is stated in the fine print; the 'one $150 incentive' limit applies to the friend's bonus incentive.
Incentive offer valid January 1, 2026 - December 31, 2026; Together CU may cancel, modify, or terminate the program at any time; cash incentives subject to 1099 reporting.

steps: Ask a Together CU team member for a referral form (or use the coupon PDF).
Fill out the MEMBER section of the form and give it to a friend or family member.
Your friend fills out their information and takes the form to the nearest branch to open a new consumer checking account.
You receive your $50 referral incentive once your friend opens their account.
